paragraphs: We are the leader in silicon and software intellectual property ("IP") enabling Physical AI - the intelligence embedded directly into billions of devices that connect, sense, and infer data in the real world. Physical AI represents the natural evolution of Edge AI. While traditional Edge AI focuses on local inference on devices, Physical AI unifies connectivity, sensing, and inference into a cohesive technology fabric. This integrated approach allows devices not only to process information at the edge but also to understand their physical surroundings, communicate seamlessly, and interact intelligently with both the environment and the cloud. As Physical AI adoption accelerates across markets, these foundational layers are becoming essential for next‑generation consumer, automotive, industrial, and mobile systems.

We are the only IP company with established leadership and deep expertise across all three foundational layers of Physical AI – connect, sense and infer. Our comprehensive portfolio powers the connectivity, perception, and intelligence capabilities of many of today's most advanced smart edge products across the consumer IoT, automotive, industrial and infrastructure, and mobile and PC markets. Devices incorporating Ceva IP have shipped in more than 20 billion units since 2003, and today our technologies are embedded in approximately 2 billion devices annually, reflecting the ubiquity and long‑term durability of our IP across multiple generations of silicon and end‑market product cycles.

Our business model centers on licensing our IP platforms, processors, software, and related technologies to semiconductor and original equipment manufacturer ("OEM") customers. These customers integrate our technologies into their application specific integrated circuits ("ASICs"), application specific standard products ("ASSPs"), and systems on chip ("SoCs"), which they manufacture, market, and sell globally. By providing pre‑validated, production‑proven IP and comprehensive software stacks, we enable our customers to reduce development time, improve performance and power efficiency, streamline certification and compliance, and bring differentiated products to market more reliably and cost‑effectively.

We operate with a global development footprint of more than 400 R&D, support, and sales professionals, reflecting the multidisciplinary expertise required to support wireless communications, advanced AI DSP architectures, AI inference engines, sensor fusion algorithms, and embedded software. Our headquarters is located in Rockville, Maryland, and we maintain development centers in France, Greece, Ireland, Israel, Serbia, and the United States. This globally distributed engineering model allows us to attract specialized talent, collaborate closely with customers in key regions, and support complex, multi‑site development programs.

We are a sustainability‑focused and environmentally conscious company. We have adopted a Code of Business Conduct and Ethics and a Sustainability Policy that emphasize environmental preservation, responsible material usage and recycling, employee welfare, data privacy, and ethical business practices. These principles guide our operations and culture at every level. We recognize that as an IP provider to high‑volume markets, our impact extends beyond our own operations and into the broader ecosystem; therefore, we remain committed to promoting responsible innovation and strengthening long‑term environmental and social stewardship.

Ceva's corporate roots date back to its incorporation in Delaware on November 22, 1999, under the name DSP Cores, Inc. Our current company was formed in November 2002 through the combination of the DSP IP licensing division of DSP Group, Inc. and Parthus Technologies plc ("Parthus"). This merger created one of the industry's first dedicated, pure‑play IP licensing companies, laying the foundation for Ceva's growth into a global leader in the technologies powering Physical AI across the connect, sense, and infer layers.

The proliferation of smart, connected devices across virtually every end market has established three essential capability layers that form the foundation of modern intelligent systems: Connect, Sense, and Infer. These layers define how devices communicate, perceive their environment, and generate real‑time intelligence at the edge.

Smart devices increasingly require multi‑standard wireless communications, spanning Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, UWB, NB‑IoT, LTE Cat‑1, 5G, and 5G‑Advanced, each evolving rapidly and becoming more complex to implement. The growing range of applications - from consumer IoT devices to automotive systems and industrial automation - demands robust, low‑power connectivity solutions integrated directly into SoCs rather than through discrete chips.

The rise of sensor‑rich products such as wearables, XR devices, smart cameras, robotics, and advanced automotive systems is driving demand for sophisticated sensor‑fusion algorithms, advanced audio processing, spatial awareness, and low‑latency perception pipelines. These workloads require specialized architectures optimized for combining data streams from cameras, microphones, inertial measurement units (IMUs), radar, and other sensors.

As Edge AI workloads shift toward increasingly complex models - including generative, transformer‑based, and multi‑modal networks - devices require highly efficient NPUs and AI‑optimized DSPs capable of delivering significant computational throughput with ultra‑low power consumption. These capabilities underpin the industry's broader transition from traditional Edge AI to Physical AI, where intelligence becomes an integral part of how devices interact with the real world.

Across these layers, technological complexity continues to rise, driven by rapidly evolving global standards such as 5G/5G‑Advanced, Wi‑Fi 7/8, Bluetooth 6/7, UWB, and the growing sophistication of embedded AI/ML workloads. At the same time, semiconductor companies face increasing pressure to accelerate time‑to‑market, reduce engineering cost, and support expanding feature sets. This combination is widening the industry's longstanding "design gap," where the pace of semiconductor manufacturing advances outstrips the availability of specialized design resources required to fully harness them. As a result, device makers are turning to licensable, production‑proven IP to overcome development bottlenecks, reduce risk, and focus internal resources on system differentiation.

In parallel, the market opportunity continues to expand. The global Physical AI and Edge AI markets together are expected to reach approximately $170 billion by 2030, reflecting explosive growth in intelligent device categories. This expansion is being propelled by sustained advancements in mobile computing, industrial automation, automotive sensing, robotics, and the rapid adoption of both generative AI and embedded AI across a wide range of end markets.

Our technology portfolio spans the full Physical AI stack and is organized into three solution pillars that collectively enable devices to connect, sense, and infer with high performance, low power, and exceptional reliability. These pillars reflect the company's long‑standing leadership across wireless connectivity, sensing, and edge AI acceleration, and they support billions of devices annually across consumer IoT, mobile, PC, industrial, infrastructure, and automotive markets.

We believe we provide the industry's broadest and most widely deployed portfolio of wireless connectivity and communications IP across short‑range, cellular IoT, and advanced 5G/5G‑Advanced domains. Our connectivity technologies are foundational to the smart edge ecosystem, powering mass‑market consumer audio devices, wearables, smartphones, IoT sensors, home networking equipment, industrial automation systems, and next‑generation infrastructure.

paragraphs: MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS

You should read the following discussion together with the consolidated financial statements and related notes appearing elsewhere in this annual report. This discussion contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Actual results may differ materially from those included in such forward-looking statements. Factors that could cause actual results to differ materially include those set forth under "Risk Factors," as well as those otherwise discussed in this section and elsewhere in this annual report. See "Forward-Looking Statements and Industry Data."

We enable Physical AI, the artificial intelligence embedded in billions of devices that connect, sense and infer data in the real world. We view Physical AI as the natural evolution of Edge AI. While Edge AI refers to running AI workloads locally on devices rather than in the cloud, Physical AI extends this concept further: it unifies connectivity, sensing and inference layers into a single fabric that allows devices not only to process data at the edge, but also to interact intelligently with their physical environment and the cloud. We believe Ceva is uniquely positioned as the only company with leadership in innovative silicon and software IP solutions across all three layers – connect, sense and infer.

According to IPnest, we commanded 68% of the wireless connectivity IP market in 2024. Since 2003, more than 20 billion devices have shipped with Ceva IP, including approximately 2.1 billion in 2025. Our technologies power the connectivity, perception and intelligence in today's most advanced smart edge products across consumer IoT, automotive, industrial and infrastructure, and mobile and PC markets. Based on market research, we believe these sectors will represent a $170 billion total addressable market for Physical AI and Edge AI by 2030.

Connectivity layer (wireless transport): Bluetooth, Wi‑Fi, Ultra‑Wideband (UWB), cellular internet-of-things (IoT), and 5G‑Advanced IP platforms that form the backbone of ubiquitous, secure, and high‑performance communication.

Sensing layer (software and DSPs): Sensor fusion processors, RealSpace spatial audio, MotionEngine software, and general‑purpose digital signal processors (DSPs) that transform raw sensor data into actionable intelligence.

Inference layer (NPUs and AI DSPs): The NeuPro family of neural processing units (NPUs), from NeuPro‑Nano for embedded AI to NeuPro‑M for generative AI, supported by a unified toolchain and software stack for simple model deployment, and the SensPro family of AI DSPs for high‑performance signal and AI workloads.
Together, these layers make Ceva, with our unified AI fabric, an essential enabler of Physical AI that breaks down barriers to entry and accelerates time‑to‑market for our customers.

For more than three decades, we have been a trusted partner to hundreds of leading semiconductor and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) companies, serving not only our largest target growth markets but also a wide variety of other applications, including smart home, surveillance, robotics and medical. Our transformative semiconductor IP and embedded software offerings are incorporated by customers into application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs) and application-specific standard products (ASSPs) to enable power‑efficient, intelligent, secure and connected devices that connect, sense and infer – the three critical pillars of the rapidly evolving era of AI‑enabled smart edge technology.

We license our portfolio of wireless communications and scalable Edge AI IP to our customers, breaking down barriers to entry and enabling them to bring new cutting-edge products to market faster, more reliably, efficiently and economically.

We believe our portfolio of technologies comprised of connectivity, sensing and inference – the three foundational layers of Physical AI – positions Ceva at the center of the most important megatrends shaping the semiconductor industry, including 5G expansion, generative and embedded AI, industrial automation and vehicle electrification. Demand across these areas continues to drive strong interest in our IP portfolio, both in established markets and in new, emerging use cases. In the fourth quarter of 2025, we signed 18 IP licensing agreements that underscore this momentum across connect, sense and infer: three NPU licensing agreements, highlighted by an engagement with a global PC and smart-device leader developing its next-generation AI personal compute architecture and selecting our NeuPro NPU IP; multiple connectivity wins reflecting customer upgrade cycles, including Wi-Fi 7 and combo connectivity agreements; and a meaningful software engagement with a leading TV platform integrating our MotionEngine technology into its smart TV operating system.

Overall in 2025, we signed 54 IP licensing agreements that underscore our momentum across connect, sense and infer: ten NPU licensing agreements, including a comprehensive portfolio license with Microchip to adopt our full NeuPro NPU family across its roadmap and embed AI capabilities across product lines; multiple agreements for our AI DSPs and accelerators across consumer and automotive applications; and close to thirty connectivity agreements for our Bluetooth and Wi-Fi IPs, including Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth High Data Throughput wins with major customers adopting next-generation connectivity standards for upcoming roadmaps. These agreements not only validate the breadth of our portfolio and the strength of our multi-IP strategy, but also support multi-year customer roadmaps and volume ramps, reinforcing Ceva's role as the enabler of Physical AI across consumer, automotive, industrial and compute markets. Strategically, the licensing agreements we signed during 2025 are building long-term royalty trajectory and visibility. Based on these signed agreements and our insight into customer roadmaps, we estimate that they represent an aggregate lifetime royalty potential of $125 million over their expected product lives. While this value will be realized over multiple years and is dependent on customer deployment and market adoption, the magnitude of this opportunity relative to our current royalty base underscores the strength, durability and accelerating momentum of the licensing and royalty flywheel we are building.

We believe the following key elements represent significant growth drivers for Ceva as the leader in silicon and software IP enabling Physical AI, spanning the three foundational layers of connectivity, sensing and inference:

Connectivity layer – Foundation for billions of devices: Our broad Bluetooth, Wi‑Fi, UWB, and cellular IoT IP platforms address the high‑volume IoT, industrial, consumer, and smart home markets. ABI Research projects more than 16.5 billion devices annually by 2029. With leadership in Wi‑Fi 6 and Wi‑Fi 7 IP, and record Wi‑Fi 6 shipments in 2025, we believe we are positioned to capture higher royalty revenues as customers transition to newer standards.

paragraphs: 本公司為在矽晶與軟體智慧財產權（"IP"）領域的領導者，推動Physical AI - 一種將智慧直接內建於十億臺裝置中的技術，這些裝置能連線、感測並在現實世界中推論資料。Physical AI代表Edge AI的自然演進。雖然傳統Edge AI著重於裝置端的本地推論，Physical AI則將連線、感測與推論整合為一體的技術結構。這種整合方式使裝置不僅能在邊緣處理資訊，也能理解其物理環境，與環境及雲端進行無縫溝通並智慧互動。隨著Physical AI在各市場的採用加速，這些基礎層正成為下一代消費性、汽車、工業與行動系統的必要元件。

本公司是唯一在Physical AI的三個基礎層（連線、感測與推論）擁有確立領導地位與深厚專業知識的IP公司。我們的完整產品組合驅動了許多當前最進階的智慧邊緣產品在消費性物聯網、汽車、工業與基礎建設以及行動與筆記型電腦市場的連線、感知與智慧能力。自2003年起，採用Ceva IP的裝置已出貨超過200億臺，而目前我們的技術每年約嵌入20億臺裝置，反映我們IP在多世代的晶片與終端市場產品週期中廣泛且長久的耐用性。

我們的商業模式以授權我們的IP平台、處理器、軟體及相關技術給半導體與原廠裝備製造商（"OEM"）客戶為核心。這些客戶將我們的技術整合至其應用特定積體電路（"ASICs"）、應用特定標準產品（"ASSPs"）與系統單晶片（"SoCs"），並在全球製造、行銷與銷售。透過提供預驗證、已驗證的生產IP與完整的軟體堆疊，我們協助客戶縮短開發時間、提升效能與電力效率、簡化認證與合規程序，並更可靠且更具成本效益地推出差異化產品。
我們在全球擁有超過400名研發、支援與銷售專業人員的開發據點，反映支援無線通訊、先進AI DSP架構、AI推論引擎、感測融合演算法與嵌入式軟體所需的跨領域專業知識。本公司總部設於馬裏蘭州Rockville，並在法國、希臘、愛爾蘭、以色列、塞爾維亞與美國設有開發中心。這種全球分散的工程模式使我們能吸引專門人才、與關鍵地區的客戶密切合作，並支援複雜的多據點開發計畫。
本公司為一個重視永續與環境意識的企業。我們已採用商業行為準則與倫理規範及永續發展政策，強調環境保護、責任材料使用與回收、員工福利、資料隱私與倫理商業實踐。這些原則指導我們在各層級的運作與文化。我們認知到作為高用量市場的IP供應商，我們的影響力不僅限於自身運作，也延伸至更廣的生態系統；因此，我們持續致力於推動負責任的創新，並強化長期的環境與社會責任。
Ceva的企業根源可追溯至1999年11月22日在特拉華州註冊成立的DSP Cores, Inc。我們目前的公司於2002年11月成立，由DSP Group, Inc的DSP IP授權部門與Parthus Technologies plc（"Parthus"）合併而成。這項合併創造了業界首間專注於IP授權的純粹型公司，為Ceva成長為推動Physical AI技術的全球領導者奠定了基礎。
在幾乎所有終端市場中，智慧連線裝置的普及已建立出三個關鍵能力層，成為現代智慧系統的基礎：連線、感測與推論。這些層次定義了裝置如何溝通、感知其環境，並在邊緣產生即時智慧。
智慧裝置越來越需要多標準無線通訊，涵蓋Wi-Fi、Bluetooth、UWB、NB-IoT、LTE Cat-1、5G與5G-Advanced，每種技術都快速演進且變得更複雜。應用範圍從消費性物聯網裝置到汽車系統與工業自動化，皆需要強固、低功耗的連線解決方案直接內建於SoCs中，而非透過離散晶片。
穿戴裝置、XR裝置、智慧相機、機械人及先進汽車系統等富含感測器的產品興起，正驅動對複雜感測器融合演算法、先進音訊處理、空間感知及低延遲感知流程的需求。這些工作負載需要專門的架構，以最佳化結合來自相機、麥克風、慣性測量單元（IMUs）、雷達及其他感測器的資料流。
隨著邊緣AI工作負載朝向越來越複雜的模型演進，包括生成式、轉換器基準及多模式網路，裝置需要高度高效的NPUs及AI優化DSP，以在極低功耗下提供顯著的計算吞吐量。這些能力是產業從傳統邊緣AI轉向物理AI的基礎，其中智慧成為裝置與現實世界互動的關鍵組成部分。

在這些層面中，技術複雜度持續上升，這是由於快速演進的全球標準，例如5G/5G-Advanced、Wi-Fi 7/8、Bluetooth 6/7、UWB，以及嵌入式AI/ML工作負載日益成熟所驅動。同時，半導體公司面臨增加的壓力，必須加快上市時程、降低工程成本，並支援擴展的功能組合。這種組合正在擴大產業長期存在的「設計缺口」，即半導體製造進步的速度超過專門設計資源的可用性。因此，裝置製造商正轉向可授權、已投入生產的IP，以克服開發瓶頸、降低風險，並將內部資源集中在系統差異化上。
同時，市場機會持續擴張。全球物理AI與邊緣AI市場合計預計在2030年達到約170 十億美元，反映智慧裝置類別的爆炸性成長。這種擴張是由於行動計算、工業自動化、汽車感測、機械人領域的持續進步，以及生成式AI與嵌入式AI在廣泛終端市場的快速採用所推動。
我們的技術組合涵蓋完整的物理AI架構，並分為三個解決方案支柱，這些支柱共同使裝置能以高效能、低功耗及卓越的可靠性進行連線、感測與推論。這些支柱反映本公司在無線連線、感測及邊緣AI加速領域的長期領導地位，並支援每年數十億裝置的消費者IoT、行動電話、個人電腦、工業、基礎建設及汽車市場。
我們相信，我們提供產業最廣泛且應用最廣的無線連線與通訊IP組合，涵蓋短距離、行動IoT及先進5G/5G-Advanced領域。我們的連線技術是智慧邊緣生態系的基礎，驅動大眾市場的消費性音訊裝置、穿戴裝置、智慧型手機、IoT感測器、家庭網路設備、工業自動化系統及下一代基礎建設。

paragraphs: 管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論分析
您應配合本年度報告中其他地方出現的合併財務報表及相關附註資料，一併閱讀下列討論。本討論包含風險與不確定性之預測性陳述。實際結果可能與預測性陳述中所包含者有重大差異。導致實際結果與預測性陳述中所包含者有重大差異之因素，包括於「風險因素」中所列舉者，以及本節及其他地方於本年度報告中所討論之其他因素。請參閱「預測性陳述與產業資料」。

我們提供Physical AI，這是一種內建於十億裝置中的智慧型人工智慧，這些裝置能連接、感測並在現實世界中推論資料。我們將Physical AI視為Edge AI的自然演進。雖然Edge AI指的是在裝置上本地執行AI工作負載，而非在雲端，但Physical AI進一步延伸此概念：它將連接性、感測與推論層整合為單一結構，使裝置不僅能在邊緣處理資料，也能與其物理環境及雲端進行智能互動。我們認為Ceva在創新晶片與軟體智慧財產權解決方案方面擁有領導地位，是唯一在連接、感測與推論三個層面皆具領導地位的公司。

根據IPnest的資料，我們在2024年無線連接性智慧財產權市場佔有68%。自2003年起，已出貨超過200億臺裝置採用Ceva智慧財產權，包括2025年約21億臺。我們的技術驅動今日最進階的智慧邊緣產品在消費性物聯網、汽車、工業與基礎建設，以及行動與筆記型電腦市場的連接性、感知與智慧。根據市場研究，我們認為這些產業在2030年將代表總可達市場規模為170十億美元的Physical AI與Edge AI。
連接層（無線傳輸）：藍牙、Wi-Fi、超寬頻（UWB）、行動網路物聯網（IoT）與5G-Advanced智慧財產權平台，構成廣泛、安全且高性能通訊的基礎架構。
感測層（軟體與DSPs）：感測融合處理器、RealSpace空間音效、MotionEngine軟體與一般用途數位訊號處理器（DSPs），將原始感測資料轉化為可執行的智慧。
推論層（NPUs與AI DSPs）：NeuPro系列神經處理單元（NPUs），從NeuPro-Nano用於嵌入式AI到NeuPro-M用於生成式AI，支援統一的工具鏈與軟體堆疊，簡化模型部署，以及SensPro系列AI DSPs用於高性能訊號與AI工作負載。
這些層次透過我們統一的AI結構，使Ceva成為Physical AI的重要推手，降低進入門檻並加快客戶的上市時程。

在超過三十年的時間裡，我們一直是數百家領先的半導體與原廠設備製造商（OEM）公司的可靠夥伴，不僅服務我們最大的目標成長市場，也服務許多其他應用領域，包括智慧家庭、監控、機械人與醫療。我們的轉型半導體智慧財產權（IP）與嵌入式軟體產品，被客戶應用於應用特定積體電路（ASICs）與應用特定標準產品（ASSPs），以實現高效能、智慧化、安全且連線的裝置，這些裝置能進行連線、感測與推論 – 這三個快速演進的 AI 使能智慧邊緣科技時代的關鍵支柱。
我們將我們的無線通訊與可擴展邊緣 AI 智慧財產權（IP）授權給客戶，降低進入門檻，並協助他們更快、更可靠、更高效且更具經濟效益地推出新穎的產品。

我們相信我們的技術組合，包含連線、感測與推論 – 這三個物理 AI 的基礎層 – 使 Ceva 站在塑造半導體產業最重要的大趨勢中心，包括 5G 擴張、生成式與嵌入式 AI、工業自動化與車輛電動化。這些領域的需求持續推動對我們 IP 組合的強烈興趣，不僅在現有市場，也在新興的應用情境中。在 2025 年第四季，我們簽訂了 18 個 IP 授權協議，這顯示了在連線、感測與推論領域的動能：三個 NPU 授權協議，其中特別是與一家全球 PC 與智慧裝置領導者合作，該公司正在開發其下一代 AI 個人計算架構，並選擇我們的 NeuPro NPU 智慧財產權；多個連線勝利，反映客戶的升級週期，包括 Wi-Fi 7 與組合連線協議；以及與一家領先的電視平台的合作，該平台將我們的 MotionEngine 技術整合至其智慧電視作業系統中。

總體而言，在 2025 年，我們簽訂了 54 個 IP 授權協議，這顯示了我們在連線、感測與推論領域的動能：十個 NPU 授權協議，包括與 Microchip 的全面組合授權，使其在其路線圖中採用我們完整的 NeuPro NPU 系列，並在其產品線中嵌入 AI 功能；多個關於我們 AI DSPs 與加速器的協議，應用於消費性與汽車領域；以及近三十個關於我們 Bluetooth 與 Wi-Fi 智慧財產權的協議，包括與主要客戶的 Wi-Fi 7 與 Bluetooth 高數據吞吐量勝利，這些客戶正在採用下一代連線標準以應對即將來臨的路線圖。這些協議不僅驗證了我們組合的廣度與我們多 IP 策略的強度，也支持客戶多年路線圖與出貨量的成長，強化 Ceva 在消費性、汽車、工業與計算市場作為物理 AI 使能者的角色。戰略上，我們在 2025 年簽訂的授權協議正在建立長期的版稅成長軌跡與可見度。根據這些簽訂的協議與我們對客戶路線圖的洞察，我們估計這些協議代表其預期產品壽命內的總版稅潛力為 125 百萬美元。雖然這個價值將在多個年份內實現，且取決於客戶部署與市場採用情況，但相對於我們目前的版稅基礎，這個機會的規模強調了我們正在建立的授權與版稅飛輪的強度、耐用性與加速動能。
我們相信以下關鍵要素代表了 Ceva 作為硅晶與軟體 IP 領先者，在物理 AI 三個基礎層（連線、感測與推論）中推動顯著成長動力：

現有及未來的授權協議及其他客戶協議所產生的版權及其他付款率可能下降，這可能會對我們的營運結果造成重大不利影響。
新的關稅、貿易措施及其他地緣政治風險與不穩定性可能會對我們的合併營運成果、財務狀況及現金流造成不利影響。
我們的成功將取決於我們是否有能力成功管理我們在地理上分散的營運。
我們在以色列的營運可能因中東地區的不穩定而受到不利影響。

如果我們目前從以色列政府獲得的補助金減少或被扣留，我們的研究與開發費用可能會增加。
我們面臨高度競爭的就業市場，並依賴有限數量的關鍵人員，這些人員難以取代，且管理及銷售團隊的變動可能對我們的營運產生不利影響。
我們的智慧財產權及相關解決方案的銷售週期較長，即使已核准的專案也可能有結構性付款條件，這使得預測我們的客戶訂單及營業收入變得困難。
我們可能透過擴展業務的方式來發展業務，這可能會導致資源分散及額外支出。
我們的產品開發工作耗時且昂貴，可能無法產生可接受的回報，甚至可能毫無回報。
我們可能無法充分保護我們的智慧財產權。
如果我們因侵權第三方的智慧財產權而被起訴，或無法以商業上可接受的條件取得這些權利的授權，將會對我們的業務造成影響。
網路安全威脅或其他安全事件可能導致我們或我們客戶的敏感資訊遭到侵害，並可能對我們的業務及聲譽造成損害。
paragraphs: 我們提醒您，下列重要因素，以及其他因素，可能會導致我們未來的實際結果與我們或代表我們在證券交易委員會（Securities and Exchange Commission） filings、新聞發佈、與投資者溝通及口頭陳述中所作出的預測性陳述有重大差異。我們年度報告中，以及在任何其他公開陳述中所作出的預測性陳述，可能最終證明是錯誤的。這些陳述可能受到我們可能做出的不準確假設，或已知或未知的風險和不確定性所影響。討論下方所提及的許多因素，將在決定未來結果時扮演重要角色。我們不承擔任何義務，公開更新任何預測性陳述，無論是因新資訊、未來事件或其他原因。然而，您應注意，我們在向證券交易委員會提交的報告中所作的進一步揭露，建議您參考。
與我們產業及市場相關的風險
我們所經營的市場具有高度競爭性，因此我們可能會遭遇銷售減少、價格下降及收入減少的情況。
由於我們的智慧財產權解決方案是終端產品的零組件，如果半導體公司及電子設備製造商未將我們的解決方案整合至其終端產品，或其客戶的終端產品未能獲得市場接受，我們可能無法產生足夠的產品銷售。
我們依賴第三方半導體智慧財產權的市場接受度。
如果我們無法滿足終端用戶的變更需求或應對市場需求的演進，我們可能無法擴大現有市場地位並進入新市場，且我們的新產品可能無法獲得廣泛的市場接受度，這可能會限制我們的額外收入機會並損害我們的業務。
